title: Image thumbnail
responsibility: Loads a small preview of one recorded design image.

inputs.name: ImageThumbnail.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace instance passed to `imageUrl` for each effect run. The component does not serialize or validate it.

inputs.name: ImageThumbnail.entityId
inputs.description: Entity identifier passed as `entityId` in the request sent to `imageUrl`. The component passes the string through without validation or transformation.

inputs.name: ImageThumbnail.version
inputs.description: Version string passed as `version` in the request sent to `imageUrl`. The component passes it through without validation or transformation.

inputs.name: ImageThumbnail.sha256
inputs.description: SHA-256 string passed as `sha256` in the request sent to `imageUrl`. The component does not verify the digest or image bytes.

inputs.name: ImageThumbnail.title
inputs.description: Text used as the `alt` value when the image is rendered. It is not rendered in the unavailable-preview fallback.

outputs.name: ImageThumbnail
outputs.description: Renders `<hx-img>` with the URL and title as `src` and `alt` when the URL string is truthy; otherwise it renders muted “Preview unavailable” text. The URL starts empty, so this fallback also appears before a URL is supplied.
